title: Cancel and supersede leave a live handoff offer open: dispose_work expires only time-expired offers, so an offered row can outlive the item's disposal until its own expiry
outcome: Cancel and supersede leave a live handoff offer open: dispose_work expires only time-expired offers, so an offered row can outlive the item's disposal until its own expiry
acceptance: Disposing an item (cancel or supersede) with a live handoff offer either cancels that offer in the same transaction with an audited event, or refuses by name until the offer is cancelled — design review decides which — and a regression test covers cancel and supersede with a live offer
`show` on the disposed item and on the offer never reports the offer as acceptable after disposal; accepting it is refused by name

completion.summary: Cancel, supersede and reject refuse a live handoff offer before disposal effects. Fresh terminal handoff acceptance/cancellation names the disposed item, current agent views hide historical offers, and committed receipts replay unchanged. Full gate passed, independent Codex/Kimi reviews found no Medium-or-higher issue, and independent acceptance passed both criteria. Clean landed binary installed and commit pushed; two Low follow-ups tracked separately.
